WITH g AS (  SELECT ST_CollectionExtract(ST_MakeValid(geometry), 3) AS geom,          ST_Envelope(geometry) AS bbox   FROM parcels WHERE parcel_id = %s) SELECT   ST_Area(geom::geography) AS area_m2,   ST_Area(bbox::geography) AS bbox_area_m2,   GREATEST(ST_XMax(bbox)-ST_XMin(bbox), ST_YMax(bbox)-ST_YMin(bbox))   / NULLIF(LEAST(ST_XMax(bbox)-ST_XMin(bbox),                  ST_YMax(bbox)-ST_YMin(bbox)), 0) AS aspect_ratio FROM g WHERE geom IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom)
